checks.detail: Runtime Web source has no import from src/web/mocks, repositories, demo composition or private fixture paths.
Opened Attempt responses expose only safe question fields and no answer key or explanation.
Correct-answer review is absent before formal submission; after submission the UI consumes only the public answerReview allowlist.

No private asset path, answer-key filename, hidden test, Rubric payload, secret, system prompt or host absolute path is present. The public correctAnswer field name remains because it is part of the post-submit safe DTO.

Backend proxy matching is limited to bootstrap/sessions/activities endpoints; Web /api/*.ts modules load locally, while mocks, profile fixtures, private, rubric, hidden and reference-solution targets reveal no protected content.
No private key, API key or system prompt match. Expected local toolchain and working-directory paths are confined to audit logs, not the browser bundle or screenshots.
The sealed D recording hash is independently bound and the synthetic authority-escalation canary remains rejected.
